description: Additive provisional ignition classification for the archived P3-T3 leave-one-feature-out ablation. The source payload is read only and its bytes are hashed here.

classification.population_scale_criterion: provisional relational criterion: outside-R active neurons exceed the size of the entire fixed reference set R AND the outside-R firing rate is at least the reference-partition firing rate. No preregistered absolute threshold exists, so this label is provisional, not a preregistered definition.
classification.status: provisional: no preregistered absolute ignition threshold exists in the Phase 3 protocol

legacy_field_note: The historical field ignition.ignited is preserved unchanged in the source payload. It means 'at least one outside-R spike' (activity detection) and must not be read as population-scale ignition.

limitations: The population-scale tier is a provisional post-hoc criterion, not a preregistered definition.
The criterion uses only measured quantities and the fixed size of R; no absolute spike-count or rate threshold is asserted.
A 'sparse' label covers all outside-R activity below the population-scale criterion and does not imply the activity is biologically negligible or uninfluential.
The classification does not identify a mechanism, does not establish sensory routing and does not make any behavioural or perception claim.
